plan.title: Buyer sees lowest best price in auction

steps.note: Start a single-stage event so the auction strategy can be configured.
Configure a price-based auction, which is the subject of the test.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add one line item for the vendors to bid on.
Invite two vendors so the buyer can compare multiple submitted bids.
Publish the auction so vendors can bid.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor bid at the higher price.
Confirm the first vendor’s bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor bid at the lower price that should become Best Price.
Confirm the second vendor’s bid was accepted.
Open the buyer’s Responses view, which is the subject of the case.
Confirm the buyer’s Responses view includes both bidding vendors.
Confirm the Responses view exposes the Best Price indicator.
Verify that Best Price equals the lower of the two submitted bids.
